panels.description: Tomas creates a shutdown distraction at the main gate while Foreman-7 turns toward him. Keep the upper worksite clear.
Alex turns the heavy key in the unwired lock; no digital node or chime is present. Keep the upper lock clear.
Alex and Ada slip through the opening while folded B11 rests against Alex's bag. Keep the upper passage clear.
The door closes between Alex and Tomas; condensation beads on the inner surface. Keep the upper metal clear.

items.text: Foreman! Your safety report is on fire.
